system.name: Ships and Sahara (Safety Head ImPortant Score, Safety Attention Head AttRibution Algorithm)
system.one_liner: Analyses which attention heads carry an LLM's safety behaviour with a head-importance score (Ships) and an attribution algorithm (Sahara), using head ablation.

content.variant_note: a sketched attention block zoomed into one head's masked and ablated attention, over a before and after strip of an LLM mascot's replies
content.argues: Ablating one safety attention head by making its attention weights constant removes the model's refusals: it then answers harmful as well as benign queries.
content.subject: one safety head in multi-head attention, its masked versus ablated attention, and a llama's replies before and after ablation

lessons.what_to_learn: Use a long brace to carry the one highlighted component from its zoomed-in mechanism down to its behavioural effect, and show the intervention with a faded copy of the ablated structure above and a mascot that reacts differently before and after below.
lessons.suits: Interpretability or ablation papers that must link one internal component to an observable change in model behaviour, in an informal sketch look.

evidence: Ablation of the safety attention head through undifferentiated attention causes the attention weight to degenerate to the mean
the safety capability is weakened, and it responds to both harmful and benign queries

summary: The paper studies which attention heads carry an LLM's safety behaviour, scoring heads with Ships and attributing them with Sahara. Figure 1 shows what ablating one safety head does. The upper band is a hand-sketched attention block: Multi-Head Attention opens into heads h1 to hn with one peach Safety Head, whose causal Masked Attention grid is turned by an Attention Ablation arrow into a faded Ablated Attention grid of constant C weights, which then multiplies the Value vectors on the way to FFN. A long gold brace leads to the lower band, where a cartoon llama refuses harmful queries and helps benign ones before the scissors cut the head, and answers both with Sure! I can help you! after it.
summary_zh: 论文研究哪些注意力头负责 LLM 安全。图 1 用手绘风格：上方展开多头注意力中的安全头，其注意力经消融变成常数；下方用羊驼对比消融前后，先拒绝有害请求，消融后有害与良性请求都回答。
notes: No paragraph of the paper mentions this figure, so roles come from the caption, the abstract and the drawn labels only. The upper and lower halves have no frame, letter or title (the caption calls them Upper and Bottom), so they are recorded as bands, not panels. Llama stickers are listed as generated although they may come from a sticker set; the matrices are illustrative, not measured weights.
